notes.subject: olsem pes bilong ol
notes.rationale: נחלה em i samting ol Papa i givim long ol pikinini — Tok Pisin i no gat wanpela tok; 'pes bilong ol' i klostu tasol

notes.subject: long namba bilong ol nem
notes.rationale: ol i skelim graun long namba bilong ol nem — pasin bilong kaunim

translation: Long ol dispela, graun bai ol skelim wantaim olsem olsem pes bilong ol — long namba bilong ol nem, ol bai kisim wanem olgeta.

tokens.gloss: bai ol skelim wantaim olsem pes bilong ol
